Congress Questions Government on Delimitation Proposal

The Congress party has questioned Union Minister Kiren Rijiju regarding a potential new government proposal on delimitation. The party specifically asked if there is a "firm NEW proposal" on the matter, urging the government to address the issue and stop what they termed "boosting news plantation."
